description: Fetch the project's public URL and the files of the last deploy (or the given paths) and report status codes, plus whether static files are being served with the local bytes. Deploys nothing.

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the COOLFTP_PROJECT setting, else the MCP server working directory.

paths.description: Paths relative to the project's remote directory to check instead of the last deploy's files

site.description: Site name. Defaults to the site in the nearest .coolftp.json, or the only saved site.

name: coolftp_verify
